title: Replace Mission Control dark theme with tend's earth-tone zen garden palette

summary.goal: Replace Mission Control dark theme with tend's earth-tone zen garden palette.

acceptance_criteria.description: globals.css contains earth-tone CSS custom properties for light mode (bg-deep: #f5f0e8, bg-primary: #ece7dd, accent-primary: #4a7c59 moss, accent-secondary: #c4703e clay)
globals.css contains dark mode tokens (.theme-dark) with warm charcoal (#1a1816) backgrounds
System preference respected via prefers-color-scheme media query
Font stack unchanged (Outfit, Inter, IBM Plex Mono) — inherited from shared-ui
All inherited components render correctly in the new palette (no neon colors visible)
Status colors use earth tones: success=#4a7c59 (moss), warning=#c4703e (clay), error=#b54a3a (brick red)

observations: ideation-ui already has a canvas theme (warm cream #f2f1ed) in its globals.css. Extend this approach to full earth-tone system.
The shared-ui preset structure stays — we override CSS variables, keep everything else.
Font stack is neutral enough for tend.

steps.title: Write earth-tone light mode tokens in globals.css
steps.description: Replace the existing globals.css color tokens with the full earth-tone palette from docs/tend-implementation.md (Theming section). :root and .theme-light get warm sand backgrounds, moss/clay accents, earth-tone status colors. Keep font imports and base styles unchanged.

steps.title: Add dark mode tokens
steps.description: Add .theme-dark class with warm charcoal backgrounds (#1a1816), lighter earth-tone text, and adjusted accent colors per docs/tend-implementation.md. Add prefers-color-scheme media query that applies .theme-dark.

steps.title: Verify component rendering and fix leaks
steps.description: Start the dev server. Visually check every inherited component (chat, blocks, layout, status bar) renders in the new palette. Hunt for any hard-coded neon colors (cyan #00d9ff, orange #ff6b35, purple #a855f7) and replace with tend tokens. Confirm fonts unchanged (Outfit, Inter, IBM Plex Mono).

architect.source_tokens: ideation-ui globals.css canvas theme as starting point
